components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary trial action on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--mint); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 700 1rem/1.1 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out), background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.84 0.15 155); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--mint-deep); outline-offset: 0.25rem; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary demo action on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; color: var(--indigo-900); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--indigo-700); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 700 1rem/1.1 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out), color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { color: var(--white); background: var(--indigo-700); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--mint-deep); outline-offset: 0.25rem; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); }

components.name: Light Button
components.css: .ds-btn-light { min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; color: var(--indigo-950); background: var(--white); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font: 700 1rem/1.1 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out), background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-light:hover { background: var(--mint); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--mint); outline-offset: 0.25rem; } .ds-btn-light:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact product filter; the only full-pill primitive.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem; color: var(--indigo-900); background: var(--indigo-100); border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 0.86rem/1.2 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { background: oklch(0.9 0.045 270); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 0.2rem solid var(--mint-deep); outline-offset: 0.2rem; }

components.name: Desktop Navigation
components.description: White ruled navigation with a precise animated underline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 5.75rem; align-items: center; gap: 2rem; padding: 0 2rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--white); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--indigo-100); font: 600 1rem/1.1 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; color: var(--indigo-900); font-size: 1.4rem; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0.25rem; height: 2px; background: var(--indigo-700); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 220ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav button { min-height: 2.9rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.2rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--mint); border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Transaction Row
components.description: Ruled product-evidence row with tabular reference and positive status.
components.css: .ds-transaction { display: grid; min-height: 6rem; grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr auto; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; color: var(--ink); background: var(--white); border-top: 1px solid var(--indigo-100); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--indigo-100); font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-transaction > span:nth-child(2) { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-transaction small { color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-transaction em { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; color: oklch(0.38 0.11 155); font-size: 0.88rem; font-style: normal; font-weight: 600; } .ds-transaction em i { width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; background: var(--mint-deep); border-radius: 50%; } .ds-document { width: 1.75rem; height: 2.2rem; border: 1px solid var(--indigo-700); border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Price Ledger
components.description: Transparent consumption pricing expressed as an aligned ruled ledger.
components.css: .ds-price { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 0 2rem; align-items: end; padding: 2.5rem 0; color: var(--ink); background: var(--white); border-top: 2px solid var(--indigo-900); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--indigo-100); font-family: 'Source Sans 3', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-price > span { align-self: center; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-price strong { color: var(--indigo-900); font-size: clamp(3.75rem, 7vw, 6rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.035em; line-height: 0.85; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-price small { grid-column: 2; color: var(--muted); text-align: right; }

narrative.overview:
EDI Spark feels like a brightly lit logistics control room after the paperwork has disappeared: calm, legible, and quietly powerful, with every connection understandable at a glance. The system gives suppliers immediate relief through plain language and large, decisive hierarchy, then proves capability through structured ledgers, transaction views, network indexes, and precise commercial detail.

The composition is architectural rather than card-led. Committed indigo fields represent dependable exchange infrastructure; white and pale indigo surfaces create breathing room; mint marks successful movement and action. Long sections use rules, asymmetric splits, and generous fluid spacing to establish pace. Desktop layouts become direct single-column stories below 58rem, while the core hierarchy and proof remain intact.

This system explicitly rejects the dated enterprise-software look associated with OpenText and TrueCommerce, jargon-heavy EDI sites, generic AI/SaaS styling, secretive pricing, and any suggestion of long or consultant-led setup.
keyCharacteristics: Committed violet-indigo infrastructure balanced by true white and a pale indigo surface
Mint used as a purposeful signal for action, connection, and success
One open humanist typeface with strong scale contrast and plain-English rhythm
Product evidence, trading-network coverage, and transparent pricing as the visual material
Flat, rule-led compositions with compact corners and almost no decorative elevation
Responsive motion that confirms exchange without gating access to content

rules.name: The Committed Indigo Rule
rules.body: Indigo must carry major structural surfaces, not appear as a timid accent scattered across a generic white SaaS page.

rules.name: The Signal Mint Rule
rules.body: Mint means action, connection, or a successful state. If an element has none of those meanings, it does not earn mint.

rules.name: The Infrastructure, Not AI Rule
rules.body: Purple gradients, neon glows, cosmic imagery, and synthetic AI symbolism are prohibited.

rules.name: The Plain-English Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Outcome first, evidence second, implementation detail on demand. Never simulate authority with dense jargon or walls of small text.

rules.name: The One Human Voice Rule
rules.body: Source Sans 3 is the brand voice. Monospace is reserved for genuine protocol or code data, never as decorative shorthand for technical credibility.

rules.name: The Numerical Confidence Rule
rules.body: Prices and document references use tabular numerals so transparent commercial information reads as stable infrastructure.

rules.name: The Grounded Surface Rule
rules.body: Sections and product evidence stay flat at rest. A shadow is allowed only when an element has genuinely moved above the page or when a compact ring communicates state.

rules.name: The One Depth Mechanism Rule
rules.body: Never combine a border with a wide decorative shadow. Use a rule, a tonal change, or elevation—one mechanism at a time.

dos: Do make complexity feel handled: lead with faster onboarding, less admin, fewer errors, and clearer document visibility.
Do prove coverage with hundreds of trading partners, every major UK retailer, and more than 300 SaaS integrations.
Do make exchange tangible through real product UI, structured document flows, trading-network indexes, and transparent price ledgers.
Do let Exchange Indigo carry major structural surfaces and reserve Connection Mint for action, connection, and success.
Do keep the canonical prices and offer durations from src/config/pricing.ts, plus the no-setup-fee and no-annual-contract terms, close to conversion actions.
Do preserve semantic structure, visible keyboard focus, WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, and the global reduced-motion alternative.
Do route technical evaluators toward API, A2A, agentic, MCP, and UBL detail without forcing that vocabulary into the supplier journey.
donts: Don't reproduce the dated enterprise-software look associated with OpenText or TrueCommerce.
Don't build a jargon-heavy EDI website that asks suppliers to understand implementation before business value.
Don't use generic AI/SaaS styling: purple gradients, neon glows, glass cards, decorative network orbs, interchangeable rounded-card grids, or synthetic AI imagery are forbidden.
Don't hide pricing or suggest long setup times, consultant-led implementation, secretive sales qualification, or inflexible annual contracts.
Don't imply an established customer history. This is a new startup; establish trust through specific, supportable product and integration evidence.
Don't use product-free decoration where real coverage, interface evidence, or technical artifacts can establish trust.
Don't repeat tiny uppercase eyebrows, decorative numbered section markers, gradient text, side-stripe accents, wide ghost-card shadows, or decorative grid backgrounds as scaffolding.
Don't exceed 0.75rem corner radii on functional containers. Full pills are reserved for filters and compact statuses.
